question: What inner condition characterizes the yogin in this intense practice?
premises: All mental activities dissolve through union with great audacity.
The mind becomes filled by a concentrated mass of its own rays.
These two descriptions characterize the same yogin.
inference: The yogin's state is marked by dissolution of all activities and saturation of the mind by concentrated self-radiance.
uncertainties: svaraśmyogha contains internal sandhi (sva-raśmi-ogha) within the single token; analyzed without splitting the row.
plain_english: All his activities dissolved through union with great audacity, his mind becomes wholly filled by a concentrated mass of his own rays.
